annotation.title_clean: Kommissionen offentliggør retningslinjer for definition af AI-systemer for at lette anvendelsen af reglerne i den første forordning om kunstig intelligens
annotation.title_en: Commission publishes guidelines on the AI system definition to facilitate the application of the first AI Act rules
annotation.summary_en: European Commission web page announcing publication on 6 February 2025 of non-binding guidelines on the AI system definition under the AI Act, helping providers determine whether software is an AI system. Lists downloadable language versions and notes the first AI Act rules applied from 2 February 2025.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines clarify practical application of the AI Act's legal definition of an AI system.
Guidelines are non-binding and will be updated over time based on experience and use cases.
Published alongside the guidelines on prohibited AI practices.
First AI Act rules, including definitions, AI literacy and prohibitions, applied from 2 February 2025.
